scope: All 1462 recovered input cases; independent of the packaging implementation.
methods: Every source NPZ was bound to its recovery-manifest SHA256 and size.

For every unchanged member, original and published compressed payloads were compared directly and with SHA256; compression method, sizes and CRC32 were also compared. Identical losslessly compressed payloads prove identical NPY bytes, including numeric values and NPY headers.

Every published member was fully read with Python zipfile, which validates decompression and CRC32. Source metadata members were read and CRC-checked directly; unchanged source members share the verified compressed payload and CRC32.
Every NPY header was inspected for object dtypes. Every Unicode/byte-string array was loaded without pickle and checked for personal absolute-path patterns.
Both extraction metadata JSON objects were compared structurally against the source with only the wrfout path prefix redacted.

source_retransmission.explanation: A damaged transport-archive member, if encountered, was replaced only by the independently retransmitted source NPZ whose size and SHA256 match the same recovery-manifest entry.

personal_path_check_scope: All NPY Unicode and byte-string members; extraction-metadata wrfout values must begin with runs/.
